info.title: HiTechCloud CRM API
info.description: Official REST API for HiTechCloud CRM: contacts, companies, deals, pipelines, stages, activities, tasks, calls, emails, meetings, notes, tags, segments, custom fields, lead sources, products, quotes, files, users and teams, plus bulk operations, CSV import/export and real-time webhooks signed with X-CRM-Signature (HMAC-SHA256).
